ex.en: The lemon has a flavor all of its own.
ex.zh: 檸檬有它獨特的味道。

ex.en: I want to start my own business.
ex.zh: 我想自己創業。

ex.en: I'm trying to find the person who owns this guitar.
ex.zh: 我在找這把吉他的主人。

ex.en: He acted like he owned the place.
ex.zh: 他表現得好像這地方是他的一樣。

ex.en: She lives on her own.
ex.zh: 她一個人住。

ex.en: I finished the project on my own.
ex.zh: 我靠自己完成了這個專案。

ex.en: Who is the owner of this house?
ex.zh: 這間房子的屋主是誰？

ex.en: Who does the car belong to when the owner dies?
ex.zh: 車主過世後，車子歸誰？

ex.en: The dog followed its owner, wagging its tail.
ex.zh: 狗搖著尾巴跟著主人。

ex.en: Tom wants to pay back the money he owes.
ex.zh: 湯姆想把欠的錢還清。

ex.en: Tom paid me back the money he owed me.
ex.zh: 湯姆把欠我的錢還給我了。

ex.en: You owe me an apology for that.
ex.zh: 那件事你欠我一個道歉。

ex.en: Thanks for your help. I owe you one.
ex.zh: 謝謝你的幫忙，我欠你一次。

owe.zh: 把⋯歸功於（owe A to B）

ex.en: He owes his success to good luck.
ex.zh: 他把成功歸功於好運。

ex.en: I owe my success to my parents.
ex.zh: 我的成功要歸功於我的父母。

ex.en: Owing to the rain, the athletic meeting was put off.
ex.zh: 運動會因為下雨延期了。

ex.en: Owing to bad weather, the flight was cancelled.
ex.zh: 由於天候不佳，班機取消了。

ex.en: Management of a company is different from ownership of a company.
ex.zh: 經營一家公司和擁有一家公司是兩回事。

ex.en: The ownership of the building changed last year.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓的所有權去年易主了。

ex.en: Home ownership is becoming harder for young people.
ex.zh: 年輕人越來越難擁有自己的房子。

ownership.zh: 當責、主人翁意識（take ownership of）

ex.en: Managers should encourage employees to take ownership of their work.
ex.zh: 主管應該鼓勵員工對自己的工作負責。

ex.en: She took ownership of the project from day one.
ex.zh: 她從第一天起就把這個專案當成自己的責任。
